queries.Q010: SELECT e.employee_id AS no, e.name AS name, e.birthDate, COALESCE(a.classification, '미지정') AS job, COALESCE(a.position, '미지정') AS position, DATE_FORMAT(em.join_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS hireDate, CASE WHEN em.rehire_same = 1 THEN '휴직' -- 휴직(1) WHEN em.rehire_same = 9 THEN '퇴사' -- 퇴사(9) WHEN em.leave_date IS NOT NULL THEN '퇴사' -- 안전망: 퇴사일 존재 시 퇴사 WHEN em.leave_date IS NULL AND em.join_date IS NOT NULL THEN '재직' ELSE '재직' END AS status, '-' AS supportCount, COALESCE(e.mobile_phone, '') AS phone, COALESCE(acc.user_id, '') AS account FROM employee e LEFT JOIN affiliation a ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN employment em ON e.employee_id = em.employee_id LEFT JOIN account acc ON e.employee_id = acc.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id ASC LIMIT [1] OFFSET [2]
queries.Q020: SELECT e.no, e.name, DATE_FORMAT(e.birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, a.job, a.position, DATE_FORMAT(e.hire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as hireDate, CASE WHEN em.leave_date IS NULL THEN '재직' WHEN em.leave_date IS NOT NULL THEN '퇴사' ELSE '재직' END as status, COALESCE(em.support_count, '-') as supportCount, e.mobile_phone as phone, a.account FROM employee e LEFT JOIN accounts a ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_meta em ON e.employee_id = em.employee_id WHERE e.employee_id = [1]
